No, I am Alisa.
And what is going on anyway?

No, she turned me down.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'where', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Макс, Насти что-то нигде нет, трубку не берёт.
examples.trans: Max, Nastya is nowhere to be found, she is not picking up the phone.

meanings.en: to cheat on, be unfaithful to
meanings.note: Prefix 'из-' ('out from within') marks extraction or exhaustion (stem 'менять'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to cheat, be unfaithful', paired with 'изменить'.

examples.trans: That means Nastya did not cheat on me!

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'how', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.trans: Help me somehow, I have been in the harem for a year already.
